title: Network DNS Config Compiler
description: Compiles DNS zone config and TLS record metadata. Enforces: all hostnames are valid FQDNs and unique, every DNS target resolves to an existing load balancer/ingress, TTL values are positive integers within policy bounds, TLS host list matches exposed host rules.

error_codes.DNS001: dns-config-spec.json missing or invalid — required: records[]
error_codes.DNS002: Hostname is not a valid FQDN
error_codes.DNS004: DNS target does not resolve to a known load balancer, ingress, or static IP
error_codes.DNS005: TTL value is not a positive integer or exceeds policy bounds
error_codes.DNS006: TLS host list does not match exposed host rules
